description.value:
Duration constant

Once per turn, when you succeed at a check or saving throw by 2 or less, you may treat it as a critical success instead. Pride doesn't do partial credit.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Once per turn, when you succeed at a check/save by 2 or less, may treat it as a critical success" is P-DEGREE-REACTIVE, specifically the margin-of-success case: "succeed by 2 or less" is not knowable to AdjustDegreeOfSuccess's predicate, evaluated before the roll resolves (adjust-degree-of-success.ts) -- before any margin exists to check.
